name: DeepSearchQA skill tuning for MiniMax M3 (you-web)

description: baseline: current pre-sync skill on seed-42 shard (no code change)

asi.hypothesis: baseline measurement of the current pre-sync skill (no code change) to anchor keep/discard
asi.iter1_plan: mechanical signature-sync: include_domains->site:cdc.gov (2x), drop offset, extraction_mode->extraction
asi.noise_observed: 0.047 spread between two baseline runs on the same 15-trial shard (0.8778 manual vs 0.8308 loop) = M3 generation variance; keep/discard must beat this to be meaningful
asi.shard: 5 tasks x k=3 = 15 trials, seed 42, 3 Single + 2 Set Answer
asi.tool_surface_lever: 13.2 calls/trial already < production 28.6; over-calling lever is small on this shard, headroom is correctness not call-count

description: iter 1: mechanical you-search signature sync (include_domains->site:, drop offset, extraction_mode->extraction). Within-noise drop; correctness baseline.

asi.behavior_change_note: the one real behavior change: site: operator now filters (include_domains was zod-stripped before, so site: was broken). This is the intended correctness fix. On the FAO task (#283, 'according to the FAO') the model may now narrow to site:fao.org — could help or over-narrow. Net effect on 5-task shard is small/noise.
asi.hypothesis: mechanical signature-sync: align skill param names to the current you-search surface (site: operator, drop offset, extraction enum). Behavior-neutral correctness baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: proceed to behavioral tuning: tool-call budget discipline + Set-Answer list discipline. If next 2 runs trend <0.80, investigate whether site: over-narrowing hurt the FAO task and soften the site: guidance.
asi.noise_context: drop 0.033 is within the 0.047 noise floor (2 baseline runs: 0.8778 manual, 0.8308 loop). sync is behavior-neutral by construction; keeping as the new correctness baseline per the approved iter-1 plan.

description: iter-2: tighter Phase 4 + tool budget — checks_failed on probe/ scratch env (fixed); metric equal-to-baseline on saturated shard

asi.env_fix: checks.sh now scopes tsc to .auto/tsconfig.checks.json (tracked src only); probe/ scratch excluded. Future runs won't stall on it.
asi.failure_diagnosis: shard is near-saturated: 4/5 tasks at 1.0. Leaks are stochastic: (a) deepsearchqa-115 trial2 = 3/3 correct but 7 EXCESSIVE authors -> F1 0.462 (answer-discipline leak); (b) deepsearchqa-762 trial0 = 0/1 correct, excluded France on bad urban-pop reasoning (search/correctness miss). The answer-discipline change targets (a) but the shard can't distinguish it from baseline (noise).
asi.hypothesis: iter-2: tighten Phase 4 answer discipline (exact set, no extras) + concrete tool budget (stop-when-found, 8-call ceiling).
asi.next_action: SWITCH eval shard to moderate-difficulty [0.3,0.7] tasks (239 available) for real headroom; re-baseline; re-apply answer-discipline there where Set-Answer excessive leaks are measurable. Holdout (50 tasks, 28 Set) remains the generalization truth-check.
asi.rollback_reason: checks failed on untracked probe/ scratch (tsc scanned gitignored files); env now fixed. Metric 0.8308 was equal-to-baseline on a near-saturated 5-task shard (4/5 at 1.0) = noise, not signal.

name: DeepSearchQA skill tuning for MiniMax M3 (hard headroom shard)

description: baseline (v2): synced skill on hard headroom shard — 5 tasks, 2 Single + 3 Set

asi.baseline_shard: hard shard v2 (seed 7): 5 tasks, 2 Single + 3 Set, prod 0.33-0.56
asi.failure_breakdown: 5/15 failures: 3 excessive-answer leaks (476 idx0/idx1 added Princeton +2; 525 idx1 added 7 extra countries, 5/5 correct but F1 0.588), 2 timeouts/failures (446 idx2 timed_out, 476 idx2 failed). 2 Single tasks (12, 804) saturated at 1.0.
asi.hypothesis: baseline of synced skill on hard shard — no code change
asi.key_lever: excessive answers on Set Answer (3/5 failures) + tool-call timeouts (2/15). Answer-discipline (no extras) + tool-budget (stop-when-found, fewer calls) directly target both.

description: iter1-v2: Phase 4 answer discipline (no extras) + concrete tool budget — +15.7% F1 (excessive leaks killed)

asi.delta: +0.1205 (+15.7%) vs baseline 0.7696 — well above 0.047 noise floor
asi.hypothesis: Phase 4 answer discipline (exact set, no extras, no padding) + concrete tool budget. Targets the 3 excessive-answer leaks + 2 timeouts observed in baseline.
asi.mechanism_note: F1 win is from answer discipline (reduced excessive answers). Tool budget '8 calls' was IGNORED — calls went UP 13.5->18. The model searches more to get the right set, which helped F1 but raised cost. Next: either enforce the budget harder or accept the higher calls if F1 keeps winning.
asi.next_action: Inspect per-task to confirm win = reduced excessive answers (not a fluke). Then either tighten Set-Answer list format or reduce the timeout failures (2/15 in baseline). Watch tool_calls as a cost signal.
asi.secondary_note: tool_calls_per_trial 13.47->18.0 (+34%) is a cost regression but F1 is the primary; secondary rarely decides. The 8-call ceiling wording is not being followed by M3.

description: iter2-v2: Output Format filtered-answer-list — regressed -6% vs best (over-corrected recall or noise)

asi.delta: -0.057 vs best 0.8901 (iter1-v2); +0.064 vs baseline 0.77. Within ~1.2x noise floor — borderline.
asi.hypothesis: Output Format: force ## Answer to be a clean filtered list (only items matching criteria), relegate non-matching to ## Evidence. Target the 525 idx2 excessive leak (16 extra countries).
asi.next_action: Discard (regression). Re-run iter1-v2 state to confirm the 0.89 best is stable (2nd data point), then target a DIFFERENT lever: either 525 excessive via a more surgical fix, or 476 over-searching (42-46 calls, misses Harvard). Output Format filtering over-corrected or was noise.
asi.rollback_reason: worse than current best (0.8901->0.8333); Output Format change added verbosity without a clear F1 win. Simpler is better — revert.

description: iter3-v2: Phase 4 filter-candidates bullet — regressed -8% (active filtering hurts recall; 2/2 filter attempts failed)

asi.hypothesis: Phase 4 bullet 4: 'filter candidates to only matching items; ## Answer is the filtered set'. Target 525 idx2 excessive (16 extra).
asi.learning: ACTIVE filtering instructions hurt (2/2 attempts regressed: Output Format -0.057, Phase4 bullet -0.071). The model over-filters and drops CORRECT items (recall loss) > the precision gain. iter1-v2's simple 'no extra items' PROHIBITION is the right level — do not add active filtering.
asi.next_action: Revert to iter1-v2 (best). Re-run iter1-v2 to get a 2nd data point — if ~0.89 the filtering changes are real regressions and iter1-v2 is the stable best; if ~0.83 the 0.89 was noise and reconsider. Then target 476 over-searching (42-46 calls, misses Harvard) via a convergence rule, NOT filtering.
asi.rollback_reason: worse than best; active-filtering hurts recall (2/2 filter attempts regressed). Revert to the 'no extras' prohibition level.
